'''Tuskcat Troopers''' were [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] riding on [[tusk cat]] mounts. They used [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]] instead of blasters and had heavier armor than regular troopers. They were also faster due to the tusk cat mounts. They were very effective against mechanized units. They could also be upgraded to heavy Tuskcat troopers, then to advanced tuskcat troopers.
